A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of the same DCS paper. Their main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original DCS classification results on three datasets, reward ablations, generation-quality measurements and qualitative analyses in Section 5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original DCS classification, ablation and image-generation results in Section 5 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The mutual boosting procedure, four reward components and diffusion/classifier updates in Section 4 and Appendix A's Algorithm 1 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use miniImageNet, CUB-200 and CIFAR-100 for the same FSCIL tasks and generation analyses. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 2 and 4 retain TOPIC, CEC, FACT, TEEN, SAVC, DyCR, ALFSCIL, OrCo and ADBS. The diffusion-model comparisons in Figure 3 and Appendix C also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Reported dataset splits, session/average accuracy metrics, backbones, training schedules and image-generation budgets are unchanged in Section 5.1 and Appendix B. The analysis protocols in Section 5.3 and Appendix C are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the sequential and leave-one-out reward ablations, generation-quality analyses, guidance-scale/image-count comparisons and qualitative examples (Tables 3 and 5–7; Figures 2–4). No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. Appendix C.2.1 retains the same qualification about high-variance generation-quality estimates from few samples.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and Figures 2–4 retain the same results. DCS average accuracies remain 68.14% on miniImageNet, 69.73% on CUB-200 and 66.36% on CIFAR-100; ablation values and qualitative findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical setup, reward definitions and Equations 1–37 are unchanged, including Appendix D's incremental MMD and variance derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims about mutual boosting, feature/logits-level rewards and FSCIL performance. Local wording edits do not alter their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reward contributions and the generation-fidelity versus challenging-sample tradeoff are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning diffusion-model quality, specialized domains, tuning, computation and inherited biases.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix B retain the same prompts, hyperparameters, preprocessing, hardware, software versions and source-library information. Added author emails do not introduce code or data access instructions.

R1.justification: Section 2's research positioning and all 82 references are unchanged. Bibliography entries move across page boundaries without adding or removing cited works.

P1.justification: v3 makes local wording and grammar edits, including Section 5.2's heading and 'present' wording. It also adds author emails, changes a corresponding-author marker and expands funding acknowledgments. The section structure and substantive narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 1–2 are slightly resized, Figure 1's caption is reworded and rewrapped, and spacing shifts Figure 3 and surrounding text. Front-matter and bibliography layout also change slightly; all figures and tables remain, and appendix layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: The contact/funding additions, local copyedits and layout adjustments leave the method, evidence, reproducibility information and complete appendices unchanged. Some grammar is corrected, while the introduction introduces 'lies the model's' by dropping 'in'. These small editorial changes leave overall paper quality effectively unchanged.
